description: This file defines the EducationService class, a service layer component that interacts with the EducationDao data access object to perform CRUD operations and business logic related to Education entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EducationService
classes.description: A service class managing business logic related to Education entities, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and validation of education data.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Saves an Education object, used for creating or updating a record.

methods.name: getEducationDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EducationDao instance.

methods.name: setEducationDao
methods.description: Sets the EducationDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by its unique ID.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education object by name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Fetches a list of Education objects matching provided search filters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Returns count of Education records matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple Education records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education name already exists, case-insensitive.
